# Fixture Permit Renewals

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Renewal

A residence permit must be renewed every 2 years. A renewal can be requested up to 30 days before the permit expires, using Form PX-118.
